description: This file defines classes for handling URL commands in kickstart installation scripts, supporting multiple RHEL and Fedora versions with version-specific options and parsing logic.

classes.name: FC3_Url
classes.description: URL command class for FC3, handling URL installation options.

classes.name: F13_Url
classes.description: URL command class for F13, extending FC3_Url with proxy support.

classes.name: F14_Url
classes.description: URL command class for F14, adding noverifyssl option.

classes.name: RHEL6_Url
classes.description: RHEL 6 specific URL class, inherits from F14_Url.

classes.name: F18_Url
classes.description: URL class for F18, supporting mirrorlist and URL options with validation.

classes.name: F27_Url
classes.description: URL class for F27, adding metalink support.

classes.name: F30_Url
classes.description: URL class for F30, supporting SSL certificate options.

classes.name: RHEL8_Url
classes.description: RHEL 8 specific URL class, inherits from F30_Url.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing URL command objects with version-specific options.

methods.name: __eq__
methods.description: Equality comparison based on URL and version-specific attributes.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: String representation of the URL command, including options.

methods.name: _getParser
methods.description: Creates argument parser with version-specific options.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command line arguments and validates exclusive options.

methods.name: set_to_self
methods.description: Sets parsed arguments to object attributes (inherited from parent).
